description: Open ONE interactive port-experience browser when the user wants excursions, tours or activities. Omit portId to let the user choose a port without calling Viator. Supply a supported local portId and optional visit date and activity keywords q to show matching experiences. This makes a fresh on-demand search; use the returned data as the current result. Preserve requested filters. Do not fetch details for every result. Users can change ports, dates, keywords and pages, inspect one selected experience and open Viator booking links. Suggestions are not verified to fit time ashore; no live availability. Use only on an experience request, never automatically for every cruise search.
name: present_excursions
title: Explore port experiences
